correccionUsuario: La mayoría de las cubiertas deben desarrollar escenas o interacciones con detalles significativos; evitar iconos aislados demasiado simples.
criterio: Motivos contrastados con los textos alternativos del catálogo y prompts del historial. Variación de motivos, paleta, escala, tipografía, alineación y composición.

seleccion.descripcion: Dos cigarras coral y azul intercambian señales desde tallos curvos, con alas dibujadas en planos verdes.
seleccion.composicion: Two large graphic CICADAS face each other on two curved teal stems: one coral, one deep cobalt. Their wings are almond silhouettes divided into 4 solid mint and plum shapes; two pairs of broad curved sound lines pass between them. Small abdomen markings, dot eyes, no insect realism. LUSH MINT GREEN background, coral/cobalt/cream, broad intersecting stems form organic composition. TITLE BOTTOM LEFT in huge deep-plum angular heavy serif, «En el principio» then «era el SEXO», SEXO cobalt. Message TOP RIGHT in dark teal bold square sans FOUR readable lines. Adult sophisticated natural-history poster drawing, not cute cartoon or detailed wings. No blossoms, hearts or extra symbols.

seleccion.descripcion: Un flamenco coral atraviesa una cinta baja con paso ligero, sobre un fondo azul con formas amarillas.
seleccion.composicion: A coral FLAMINGO gracefully ducks its curving neck under a taut yellow LIMBO RIBBON between two short navy posts while lifting one leg in a playful deliberate step. Featherless smooth silhouette, one cream-black beak, tiny dot eye. Broad flat yellow ground stripe links the posts. Saturated SKY BLUE backdrop with coral/ochre/ivory. Title UPPER LEFT in dark navy heavy rounded sans, «La felicidad» largest and «como ventaja» offset right. Message lower-right in ivory bold italic serif, 3 lines 90px. Artwork crosses center diagonally and is expressive through movement, no tropical leaf/palm/flowers. Extremely flat vector poster with one uniform color per body part.

seleccion.descripcion: Un tamiz azul separa piezas angulosas de pequeños puntos que forman un patrón ordenado sobre fondo coral.
seleccion.composicion: An imaginative graphic composition WITHOUT PEOPLE OR HANDS. A large COBALT SIEVE tilts diagonally across a vivid CORAL cover. Above it, an irregular cluster of four dark plum geometric chunks enters the sparse grid; below it falls a precise stream of cream dots that progressively align into three orderly curved rows. A single mint handle links the diagonal composition, sieve built as plain flat ellipse and 6 grid strokes, no metallic volume. Meaningful visual process with lively negative space, NOT a lonely icon. Title TOP LEFT deepblue heavy italic slab serif «El arte / de pensar». Message BOTTOM RIGHT darkplum bold condensed sans, 3 lines90px. Crisp flat print colors, no gradients, no bowls.

seleccion.descripcion: Una pinza azul sujeta una tela roja azotada por un viento dibujado con grandes curvas, sobre fondo amarillo.
seleccion.composicion: NO PEOPLE OR HANDS. A giant flat COBALT CLOTHESPIN anchors a vivid RED SAIL-LIKE FABRIC to a strong navy clothesline. The cloth bends wildly into three broad coral-red angular folds while three expressive blue wind ribbons sweep around it, illustrating resistance and stability. Clothespin only two flat blue bars and one cream spring spiral, seen front-on with no depth/gradient. GOLDEN YELLOW background, deep navy small grounded corner. Title BOTTOM RIGHT navy extra-bold condensed uppercase with «FUERZA» huge and «de voluntad» heavy serif. Exact message TOP LEFT plum heavy rounded sans FOUR lines85px. Bold developed interaction of fabric, wind and fastener, no isolated-object look, no extra props.

seleccion.descripcion: Un tucán coral y azul proyecta grandes ondas geométricas desde una rama escalonada, sobre fondo naranja y malva.
seleccion.composicion: NO PEOPLE. A beautifully FLAT TOUCAN with huge geometric beak in cream and coral and body in cobalt/plum stands confidently on a thick stepped mauve branch. Its open beak sends three strong concentric angular cream arcs across orange ground, arcs wrap into a striking fan-like graphic field behind the title without touching letters. Three broad teal tail feathers counterbalance lower-right; one simple dash eye. Vivid TANGERINE backdrop and mauve lower patch. Strong screenprinted cut-paper drawing, not realistic bird feathers. Title UPPER RIGHT IVORY irregular bold slab serif, «El mito del» smaller and «carisma» huge cobalt. Exact message BOTTOM LEFT darkplum heavy condensed sans FOUR lines85px. Visually developed through rhythmic forms and negative space, no flowers, other birds, microphones or stage.

seleccion.motivo: pájaro carpintero y pandereta / woodpecker tambourine
seleccion.descripcion: Un pájaro carpintero azul y coral percute una pandereta marfil que cuelga de un soporte verde sobre fondo violeta.
seleccion.composicion: NO HUMANS OR HANDS. An expressive graphic WOODPECKER, cobalt body with a coral crest and cream face patch, drums its long navy beak against an oversized CORAL TAMBOURINE suspended from a clean mint forked wooden support. Tambourine is flat ivory circle with six simple cream cymbal discs around coral rim; three broad vibration strokes convey practice. Woodpecker tail extends down-left, exactly two small feet grip the support. Vivid VIOLET background, cream/mint/coral/cobalt. Title TOP LEFT in mint heavy geometric sans with «talento» huge ivory rounded serif. Message BOTTOM RIGHT ivory strong condensed sans FOUR lines85px. Original witty adult flat poster, every area SOLID color, no feathers drawn individually and no extra symbols.

seleccion.descripcion: Una mantis verde abre con precisión una avellana azul junto a sus dos mitades, sobre fondo rosa.
seleccion.composicion: A large MANTIS in solid emerald and dark-green geometric shapes methodically opens a giant COBALT HAZELNUT with precise folded forelegs; nut's two halves reveal warm ivory kernel, one shell half rests lower-left. Mantis composed of clearly simplified long arms, angular triangular head and two little ivory eyes without iris. Hot ROSE PINK background, emerald/cobalt/cream. Title BOTTOM LEFT in dark green ultra-bold block sans 3 staggered lines, «PSICÓPATAS» largest. Message TOP LEFT in navy heavy italic serif FOUR short lines85px. Beautiful controlled visual tension, no realistic insect texture, no weapons or violence, no gradients. Give scene scale and purposeful action.

seleccion.descripcion: Una mujer se quita una escafandra grande para volver a escuchar, con dibujo plano coral y azul sobre fondo menta.
seleccion.composicion: A simple adult woman with plum block hair, solid brown skin and coral shirt lifts an oversized vintage DEEP-SEA DIVING HELMET away from her head using exactly two simple hands. Helmet round COBALT silhouette with one pale-yellow front porthole and 4 small flat bolt dots, no glossy brass. Her calm closed dash eyes emerge into open space, revealing expression without realistic features. MINT background with cream negative-space crescent around head. Title TOP LEFT in enormous dark plum condensed sans «SIN / GASOLINA», GASOLINA coral on mint. Message lowerleft in deepblue heavy rounded serif THREE lines90px. Art fills right and middle, clear freeing gesture, no ocean waves/fish/pipes.
